Scaling Contract Size in Sim Funded & Brokerage Accounts

Updated this week

For those that may not understand how margin scaling works with contract size, in a Sim Funded/ Brokerage Account, please refer here:

 

$ 3500 3 Minis and 35 Micros

$ 3000 3 Minis and 30 Micros

$ 2000 2 Minis and 20 Micros

$ 1500 1 Mini and 15 Micros

 

Just because you are in a SIM Funded Account doesn't mean our Brokers won't scale the size.

 

✅ Tradovate especially can scale during News events.

 

As listed here:

 

https://www.tradovate.com/resources/markets/margin/

 

=> Most Sim Funded Accounts start with 5 Minis and 50 Micros and can be adjusted with your growth of the account. Ask support for help once you grow the account:

 

BluSky Support Desk

 

 

✅ On the same note, the available contract limit can also decrease the lower your account balance gets.


=> Clarification on Scaling Per Platform:
​

Tradovate runs their Sim Funded Accounts on the same software and principles as their LIVE Brokerage account software.

Project X scales up with account growth.

Rithmic does not scale.

Volumetrica does not scale. 
​

Sweets Futures (Rithmic) Brokerage Accounts Margin Scale on account size.
